title: Fix tool routing 404 errors and restore first batch of 10 missing tools

requirements.text: Audit all route definitions in frontend/src/App.tsx to identify tools showing 404 errors. Verify that route paths match the /tools/{category}/{tool-slug} URL pattern and that lazy-loaded component imports reference existing component files. Fix any mismatches between route paths, component file locations, and component names.

requirements.text: Update tool metadata in frontend/src/constants/tools.ts for the first batch of 10 missing tools. Add complete metadata entries including name, slug matching route pattern, description (3-5 words), category matching existing category IDs, tags array (5-8 relevant keywords), icon (valid Lucide React icon name), pricing information (isFree: true, cost: '0.00'), isNew: false flag, usabilitySteps array with 4-6 numbered instructions, about object with comprehensive content (introduction paragraph, keyFeatures array with 4-6 bullet points, whoBenefits array with 2-3 user personas, whyChoose array with 2-3 competitive advantages), and faqs array with 5-7 relevant questions and detailed answers.

Document which categories received new tools and their current tool counts for tracking progress toward the 125-tool goal.

Use only technologies specified in the platform: Motoko backend, React with TypeScript frontend, Tailwind CSS, Three.js for 3D if needed
nonGoals: Restoring all 40 missing tools in a single build (will be done in subsequent batches)
